name: Express Entry (FSW / CEC)
shortDescription: Points-based federal route favoring skilled workers with strong language and education.

requirements.description: Minimum 1 year of continuous skilled work experience.
Minimum language level of CLB 7 (IELTS 6.0 in all bands or CEFR B2).
Advanced language level (CLB 9+ / CEFR C1+).
Proof of settlement funds (approx $10k+ USD) unless currently working in Canada.
Bachelor's degree or higher.
Master's degree or PhD.
Age between 20 and 29.
Occupation in STEM or Healthcare.

name: Skilled Worker Visa
shortDescription: Employer-sponsored route requiring a confirmed job offer and minimum salary.

requirements.description: Must hold a Certificate of Sponsorship from a licensed UK employer.
requirements.resolutionActionName: Secure a licensed UK Sponsor Job Offer

requirements.description: Minimum salary threshold (£38,700/yr general, lower if under 26 or shortage).
requirements.resolutionActionName: Negotiate higher salary or find high-paying role

requirements.description: English language proficiency of at least CEFR B1 (IELTS 4.0).
requirements.resolutionActionName: Pass IELTS for UKVI with minimum 4.0

name: H-1B Specialty Occupation
shortDescription: Employer-sponsored nonimmigrant visa for specialized roles requiring a degree.

requirements.description: U.S. employer sponsorship required.
requirements.resolutionActionName: Secure a US Employer willing to sponsor H-1B

requirements.description: Minimum of a Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a related field.

name: DE Rantau Nomad Pass
shortDescription: A digital nomad visa for IT and digital professionals earning a minimum income.

requirements.description: Minimum annual income of $24,000 USD.
requirements.resolutionActionName: Secure a remote job with higher salary

requirements.description: Must be an IT or digital professional.

name: Skilled Independent Visa (Subclass 189)
shortDescription: A points-tested visa for invited workers with skills Australia needs.

requirements.description: Competent English (IELTS 6.0 in all bands or equivalent).
Age under 45 years.

name: EU Blue Card
shortDescription: A residence title for academics and highly qualified workers from outside the EU.

requirements.description: A recognized university degree.
A valid employment contract or binding job offer in Germany.
requirements.resolutionActionName: Secure a job offer in Germany

name: Digital Nomad Visa
shortDescription: Visa for non-EU remote workers and freelancers.

requirements.description: Minimum monthly income of 200% of the Spanish minimum wage.
requirements.resolutionActionName: Secure remote income of at least ~2,500 EUR/month

name: Golden Visa
shortDescription: Long-term residence visa for specialized talents, investors, and outstanding students.

requirements.description: Monthly salary of at least 30,000 AED (~8,100 USD) for professionals.

name: Highly Skilled Professional Visa
shortDescription: A points-based system for highly skilled foreign professionals.

requirements.description: Minimum 70 points on the HSP point calculation table (Education, Experience, Salary).

name: Destination Thailand Visa (DTV)
shortDescription: A 5-year multiple entry visa for remote workers and digital nomads.

requirements.description: Proof of funds of at least 500,000 THB (~14,000 USD).
